title: Super Krawtchouk Polynomials via Lie Superalgebras
summary: Multivariate extensions of the Krawtchouk polynomials have been studied by numerous authors in recent decades by exploring new connections to probability, representation theory and quantum integrability. We develop a theory of multivariate super Krawtchouk polynomials using the representation theory of the general linear Lie superalgebra, extending results of the first author in the classical setting.
